question: Which of the following passes is located in Western Ghats of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhor Ghat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Bhor Ghat:**

 
• It is a mountain pass located in **Lonavala, Maharashtra in the Western Ghats**.
 
• It connects **Mumbai to Pune**.
